items.text: Your HR Self-Service Shouldn't Live Outside Your Microsoft Cloud

You have moved your business systems to Azure. Identity is centralized in Azure Active Directory. Data lives in Dataverse. Analytics runs on Power BI. So why is your employee self-service portal still a standalone third-party app fighting the stack it is supposed to live in?
Two identity systems to manage
A standalone ESS means a second login for staff and a second directory outside Azure Active Directory for IT.
Data outside your Azure tenant
Employee records, leave balances, and expenses in a vendor database instead of your Dataverse and your Azure region.
Compliance you can't audit end-to-end
Your Azure workloads are SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR-covered. Your third-party ESS isn't necessarily.
No Power Platform reach
Standalone ESS data can't be surfaced in Power BI or automated with Power Automate without brittle connectors.
Contractors and deskless staff left out
Third-party bolt-ons were never designed for the phone-first workforce or the license-limited contractor.
An Employee Self-Service Layer Built Into Your Microsoft Cloud
What You Can Use Folio3 ESS For

The app is organized around the four everyday workflows that generate the most HR support tickets in a Microsoft-cloud environment. Each has scoped access, its own screens, and a distinct adoption curve.
What Folio3 ESS Can Do
Every capability the app ships with maps to a Microsoft service you already run. No new vendor infrastructure to procure, secure, or maintain.
Azure-Native Hosting
Deploys into your Azure environment with the same regions, compliance posture, and network policies as the rest of your Microsoft workloads.
Azure Active Directory SSO
One login across Outlook, Teams, Business Central, and Folio ESS. Conditional access, MFA, and privileged identity management supported.
Native Dynamics 365 HR Integration
Reads and writes directly to Dataverse. No middleware, no nightly sync, no shadow database. Employee records stay where they belong.
Power Platform Extensibility
Build with Power Apps components, automate approvals with Power Automate, and surface HR data in Power BI without adding new infrastructure.
Cross-Platform Mobile App
Native iOS and Android apps with the same role-based experience as the web app. Single sign-on through Azure Active Directory on every device.
A Native Mobile App for iOS and Android

The mobile app is a first-class part of Folio ESS, not a mobile-web wrapper. It carries the same role model, the same permissions, and the same Azure Active Directory sign-in your workforce uses on the desktop, into a form factor built for warehouses, construction sites, retail floors, and traveling staff.
Approval alerts pushed to the phone the moment a request is filed
Camera capture for receipts, IDs, and compliance documents
Read access to key records when there is no data connection
Role and access rules identical to the web app on every device
Azure Active Directory sign-in with conditional access enforced
A Closer Look Inside Folio ESS
Five Reasons Enterprise Buyers Choose It Over a Bolt-On
Runs where your other Microsoft workloads run
Same Azure region, same tenant, same operational model. No new vendor cloud to reason about.
Uses the identity you already manage
Azure Active Directory, conditional access, and multifactor authentication out of the box.
Inherits your compliance posture
SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR covered by the underlying Azure and Microsoft services you already audit.
Extensible with Power Platform
Customize with the same tools your teams already use for other Microsoft apps.
Delivered by a Microsoft Solutions Partner
Folio3 supports the app alongside Azure, Business Central, and Power Platform work.
